claims.quote: Parosphromenus linkei is a liquorice gourami from Central Kalimantan province in Indonesian Borneo, described from creeks near Sukamara.

Described from 'Creeks in Pudukuali, 2 kilometers north of Sukamara and Tarantang, Kalimantan Tengah, Borneo', which refers to the village of Pudu in Sukumara district, West Kotawaringin Regency, Central Kalimantan province, Indonesia (Borneo).
Parosphromenus linkei comes from the Indonesian part of Borneo, from the province of Kalimantan Tengah.
